product.name: 2025 eCTF insecure example decoder (MITRE reference design)

components.name: eCTF 2025 insecure example decoder firmware (first-party)
components.notes: decoder/src/*.c and decoder/inc/*.h. Headers carry MITRE copyright and an 'educational purposes only' statement but no licence line; licence concluded from the root LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0, Approved for Public Release, Case 24-03351-Code).

components.name: Maxim Integrated MAX78000 startup code (startup_firmware.S)
components.notes: MIT permission text plus Maxim branding-policy and 'no other IP licence implied' clauses. ScanCode reports MIT AND LicenseRef-scancode-proprietary-license; the proprietary match is the IP-retention clause, not a use restriction (checked against the file). Adapted for the eCTF bootloader (firmware_startup entry), so treated as modified. Licence text is in the file header only.

components.name: Maxim Integrated MSDK project Makefile
components.notes: Build script only; adds the eCTF crypto-example and DECODER_ID flags.

components.name: Analog Devices MSDK (CMSIS device files, PeriphDrivers, Board support FTHR_RevA)
components.path: (downloaded at build time: /root/msdk-2024_02 in the decoder Docker image)
components.notes: Not in the repository, so not scanned. Fetched by decoder/Dockerfile from GitHub and compiled into the image via libs.mk (LIB_BOARD and LIB_PERIPHDRIVERS are on by default). Expected to be Apache-2.0 for most files with older Maxim MIT-style headers on some; the exact per-library licences of v2024_02 must be confirmed from the MSDK source before release.

components.name: newlib-nano C library (from Ubuntu gcc-arm-none-eabi / libnewlib-arm-none-eabi)
components.notes: Assumed linked (MSDK GCC build uses newlib-nano specs). Mostly BSD-style permissive licences under per-file notices (COPYING.NEWLIB); generally considered fine for proprietary firmware but attribution applies. Not confirmed by a linker map.

components.name: libgcc (GCC runtime support)
components.notes: Runtime Library Exception permits linking into proprietary firmware when compiled with an eligible compilation process. Assumed linked; no linker map.

components.name: wolfSSL / wolfCrypt (optional eCTF Crypto Example)
components.notes: Disabled (project.mk CRYPTO_EXAMPLE=0) and not in the repository. If enabled, decoder/Makefile adds wolfssl/wolfcrypt/src to VPATH and compiles it statically into the firmware. Current wolfSSL releases are GPL-3.0-or-later (releases before 5.6.6 were GPL-2.0-or-later); a commercial licence is available from wolfSSL Inc.

components.name: GNU Arm Embedded toolchain (gcc-arm-none-eabi, binutils-arm-none-eabi, gdb, gdb-multiarch)
components.notes: Build and debug tools inside the build container only.

components.name: GNU Make, libtool, texinfo, git, wget, unzip (build container utilities)
components.notes: GPL family and permissive; build container only, never shipped.

components.name: Ubuntu base image
components.notes: Build environment; not distributed to device recipients.

components.name: ectf25_design (host design package)
components.notes: Host-side secrets / subscription / encoder tooling. Treated as internal (not distributed with the device). pyproject.toml has no license field; licence concluded from the root LICENSE.txt.

components.name: ectf25 (host tools package)
components.notes: Host tooling (flash, tester, satellite, uplink, tv). Treated as internal. pyproject.toml has no license field.

components.name: loguru
components.notes: Runtime dependency of both host packages. Licence from public package metadata knowledge; not verified offline (no lockfile, package not installed in the repo).

components.name: pyserial
components.notes: Host tools dependency. Licence not verified offline.

components.name: tqdm
components.notes: Host tools dependency; file-level copyleft (MPL-2.0) parts, used unmodified. Licence not verified offline.

components.name: psutil
components.notes: Host tools dependency. Licence not verified offline.
